All coordination with the security team will be done through the PRSC Program Management Office. SARs will not be approved without documented vetting by the security team. A DISS (Defense Information System for Security) request MUST be submitted for access to Restricted Areas for all cleared personnel. 5. Service Summary: Performance Objective PWS Reference Acceptable Quality Level (AQL) Method of Surveillance 1. Perform On-Site Structural Inspection & Analysis Section 3.1 & 3.2 100% of defined inspection areas evaluated. Site inspection must be physically led by a certified Alaska- licensed Professional Engineer (PE). No safety violations during site visit. 100% Inspection / Direct Observation by Government Site POC. 2. Deliver Initial Draft Technical Report Section 3.3 Delivered No Later Than (NLT) 7 calendar days after work on site is performed. Report must include all 5 required elements (summary, methods/photos, observations, investigation recs, repair recs). Zero missing sections. 100% Review by Government Program Manager / Lead Engineer. 3. Deliver Final Comprehensive Technical Report Section 3.3 & CDRL A001 Delivered NLT 30 days after work on site is performed. Document must be officially certified/stamped by an active Alaska- licensed PE. Must successfully incorporate or address 100% of Government 100% Review by Government Lead Engineer / Technical Evaluator. 7 comments generated from the Draft Report review. 4. Conduct Technical Interchange Meeting (TIM) Section 3.4 Scheduled and held NLT 14 calendar days aft
